description: p2's input with `constructor: 1` added. Every JavaScript object inherits a property of that name, so an engine that looks names up in a plain object (`name in table`, `table[name]`) finds it and reads the member as defined. The suite does not define it, and the record rejects with unknown_member_reject. p2 is the accepting twin. Rests on `defined_members` in MANIFEST.json.
